title: Ninth Floor
summary: A smoke break at a 9th-floor window while a post-Soviet district runs from dawn to dusk.
description: First-person view of a man smoking at his 9th-floor window in a panel block while the post-Soviet district outside goes from dawn to dusk in warm yellow and orange tones. PSX-style low-poly 3D at full resolution with real light and sun shafts through the smoke. One self-contained HTML file; no assets. Built by Qwen 4 Max Preview in DeepSeek Harness with high reasoning from the same prompt as the other 7 entries in this comparison, then revised over 2 to 5 rounds of feedback with screenshots taken on a real GPU.
